record.question: Who is named as the world’s best player for 2017 by FIFA?
record.explanation: FIFA's 23 October 2017 announcement names Cristiano Ronaldo the Best Men's Player. Printed Christiano is a spelling error. Historical exam context: 2018 (year only; no day/month printed). This is the source-era answer; time-sensitive roles, rankings and memberships may have changed. Evidence: https://inside.fifa.com/media-releases/cristiano-ronaldo-and-lieke-martens-cap-dream-season-at-the-best-fifa--2916955 Independently checked solution, unofficial. No matching examiner answer key is asserted.
